shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo '__NO_ROUND_BRIEF__'; fi
sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
lore-query-trace --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p' || true
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md
git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry validation lint findings" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
